Juvenile offender-Age-Determination-Reckoning date-Held: The reckoning date for determining the age of the Juvenile offender is the date of offence D 2000 Act-Applicability of-To the cases initiated under 1986 Act, pending on the date of enforcement of 2000 Act-Held: The Act of 2000 would be applicable to such cases only when the accused had not attained 18 years of age on the date of its enforcement-Model Rules framed by
